scripts.build: vite build && node -e "for (const dir of ['assets', 'audio']) require('fs').cpSync(dir, 'dist/' + dir, { recursive: true })"
scripts.build:legacy: vite build --config legacy/vite.config.js && node -e "for (const dir of ['assets', 'audio']) require('fs').cpSync(dir, 'dist-legacy/' + dir, { recursive: true })"
